name: Overlay
summary:
# Overlay: Revolutionizing Your Daily Routine with Immersive Web Browsing
Imagine being able to browse your favorite websites, watch videos, and stay entertained while still being productive and tackling your daily chores. Welcome to Overlay, the innovative VR web browser that follows you wherever you go!

## **Access Your Favorite Media Sites**

With Overlay, you can seamlessly access popular media sites like:
* YouTube: Watch your favorite videos, music, and live streams in stunning VR
* Twitch: Catch you
